item.title: Microsoft announces Scout, an autonomous AI agent built on OpenClaw
item.description:
📝 Microsoft Scout, unveiled at the company’s Build event Tuesday, is a new type of always-on agent based on the OpenClaw agent framework that Microsoft calls “autopilots. Microsoft did not immediately provide additional details about pricing. ” Microsoft said it will also contribute upstream to the open-source OpenClaw project.

item.title: Open Repair Data Standard – Open Repair Alliance
item.description:
📝 Open Repair Data Standard The Open Repair Data Standard (ORDS) defines a shared approach towards collecting and sharing repair data about small electricals and electronics. Fields: Problem; Repair Status; Repair Barrier. Session related: Information about when the repair took place and through which community repair group.
🔗 Read more: https://openrepair.org/open-data/open-standard/

item.title: Show HN: RePlaya – self-hosted browser session replay with live tailing
item.description:
📝 RePlaya Self-hosted session replay built on S2. Session streams use timestamping. S2 lists streams in lexicographic order, so each stream is named sessions/<inverted timestamp>; streams.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/s2-streamstore/replaya
